title: A METHOD OF CAPTURING AND SEQUESTERING CO2 FROM A GAS
docs.abstract: The invention provides a method of capturing CO2 from a gas and sequestering the CO2 by carbonation comprising the steps of: contacting a gas comprising CO2 with a capture solution; dissolving CO2 in the capture solution to form a modified capture solution comprising dissolved CO2 species; contacting a mineral source with the modified capture solution to leach carbonate forming species from the mineral source into the modified capture solution, such that the carbonate forming species reacts with the dissolved CO2 species in the modified capture solution to form a metal carbonate; wherein the mineral source comprises one or more of a silicate, a hydroxide, an oxide, magnesium, calcium or iron cations; wherein the capture solution comprises an initiator salt and one or more of a promoter or a buffer salt, wherein the promoter is configured to accelerate the rate of dissolved CO2 species formation in the capture solution.

METHOD OF CAPTURING A TARGET SPECIES FROM A GAS
docs.abstract: A method of capturing a target species from a gas comprises the steps of: contacting a gas (108) containing a target species with a first absorbent solution (110) comprising a capture species; dissolving the target species in the first absorbent solution to form a target anion; electrochemically separating the target anion from the first absorbent solution by contacting the first absorbent solution with one or more ion-exchange membranes (114, 116), and transferring the target anion through an ion-exchange membrane (114) into a second absorbent solution (134); and releasing at least some of the target species from the second absorbent solution. The one or more ion-exchange membranes are not permeable to the capture species, so the capture species does not pass through the one or more ion-exchange membranes. An apparatus (100) for capturing a target species from a gas is also provided.

title: METHOD OF CAPTURING CO2 FROM A GAS MIXTURE
docs.abstract: Method of capturing CO2 from a gas mixture (108) comprising the steps of: contacting the gas mixture (108) with a capture solution (110); dissolving CO2 in the capture solution to form a modified capture solution comprising bicarbonate ions; performing electrodialysis on the modified capture solution using a bipolar membrane electrodialysis system (104) to transfer bicarbonate ions into a release solution (121) and regenerate the capture solution; wherein the capture solution comprises a metal carbonate, and wherein the capture solution contacts or comprises a promoter which accelerates the rate of bicarbonate formation in the capture solution.

気体から標的種を捕捉する方法
docs.abstract: 標的種を含有する気体（１０８）を、捕捉種を含む第１の吸収液（１１０）と接触させる工程と；標的種を第１の吸収液に溶解し、標的アニオンを形成する工程と；第１の吸収液を、１つまたは複数のイオン交換膜（１１４、１１６）と接触させることによって、標的アニオンを第１の吸収液から電気化学的に分離し、標的アニオンを、イオン交換膜（１１４）を通して第２の吸収液（１３４）へ移動させる工程と；少なくとも一部の標的種を第２の吸収液から放出する工程とを含む、気体から標的種を捕捉する方法。１つまたは複数のイオン交換膜が、捕捉種に対して透過性ではないため、捕捉種は、１つまたは複数のイオン交換膜を通過することはない。気体から標的種を捕捉するための装置（１００）もまた提供される。 【選択図】図１
